overall_intent: Requester meaning is a sports-themed test using the attached visual reference. The reviewed exact antecedent 스포츠물 resolves the current anaphor. Relay athletics is the randomly allocated agent-owned domain, not a requester restriction. I compared a solitary runner awaiting her relay turn with a two-runner exchange; the shared baton makes cooperative timing and the transfer of effort legible, so I choose a final 4 x 400 exchange. The teammate has just completed a hard lap; the primary runner begins her next effort. Their common baton, strain, and forward space show the transition without asserting a real biography. Face and hair reference use is confined to visible appearance; the kit, other runner, track, framing and moment are replaceable authorial choices. Sensual 1 supports alert facial presence and physical purpose; fetish 0, surreal 0 and restrained creativity 1 preserve the coherent athletic moment. Both contact boundaries, connected arms and grounded shoes receive simultaneous projected space in the same image; the exchange takes visual priority over a close facial crop.
